arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has a power failure and says it can't be repaired (their own web research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property, not on the inventory, and they would take it when they leave. Do you consent to this? Please also tell us who pays to disconnect and remove the old machine and fit the new one, and what should happen to the old machine (inspect, repair or dispose). Alternatively we can send our contractor to inspect it.
options: Consent to tenant's own replacement (tenant's machine stays theirs); say who pays for removal/disposal of the old one and fitting
Send our contractor to inspect/repair the landlord's machine first

arguments.note: Tenant wants own replacement washing machine: needs landlord consent, not a standard repair. Tenant's machine stays theirs, not on inventory, removed at end of tenancy. Landlord's LG machine disposition and who pays disconnect/removal/fitting asked of landlord. Fault diagnosis is tenant's own, unverified. Intake severity routine.

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the current one belongs to the landlord, we need their consent before you replace it. We've passed on your offer, including that the new machine would be yours and you'd take it with you when you leave, and asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one. Please don't disconnect or dispose of the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 1 August, or sooner if the landlord replies.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has a power failure and says it can't be repaired (their own web research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property, not on the inventory, and they would take it when they leave. Do you consent to this? Please also tell us who pays to disconnect and remove the old machine and fit the new one, and what should happen to the old machine (inspect, repair or dispose). Alternatively we can send our contractor to inspect it.
options: Consent to tenant's own replacement (tenant's machine stays theirs); say who pays for removal/disposal of the old one and fitting
Send our contractor to inspect/repair the landlord's machine first

arguments.note: Tenant wants own replacement washing machine: needs landlord consent, not a standard repair. Tenant's machine stays theirs, not on inventory, removed at end of tenancy. Landlord's LG machine disposition and who pays disconnect/removal/fitting asked of landlord. Fault diagnosis is tenant's own, unverified. Intake severity routine.

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the current one belongs to the landlord, we need their consent before you replace it. We've passed on your offer, including that the new machine would be yours and you'd take it with you when you leave, and asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one. Please don't disconnect or dispose of the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 1 August, or sooner if the landlord replies.
